relationships.subject: Spinal cord injury
relationships.evidence_quote: SCI upregulated CGRP⁺ dorsal horn terminals without affecting IB4⁺ fibers, while SNI abolished both CGRP⁺ and IB4⁺ terminals.

relationships.subject: Sciatic nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: SCI upregulated CGRP⁺ dorsal horn terminals without affecting IB4⁺ fibers, while SNI abolished both CGRP⁺ and IB4⁺ terminals.

key_findings: SNI causes severe muscle atrophy and NMJ denervation whereas SCI causes mild atrophy with intact NMJs.
SCI upregulated CGRP+ dorsal horn terminals; SNI abolished CGRP+ and IB4+ terminals.
